results.description:
For the needlepoint obsessed.

Stitchpoint is the free needlepoint app for tracking canvases, threads, stitches, and the community of stitchers around you. Track every canvas from kit to finished piece. Search your needlepoint notions. Learn new stitches. Find the needlepoint shops near you. Find your next project in another stitcher's finished piece.


WHAT YOU GET

PROJECT TRACKING
Every needlepoint project, from the moment you pick a canvas to the day it comes back from the finisher. Every WIP, every finished piece.

YOUR NOTIONS, ORGANIZED
Threads, wools, silks, ribbons, beads, needle minders, stretcher bars. Know what is in your stash before you buy that DMC 310 again.

THE LNS DIRECTORY
Local needlepoint shops, wherever you are. See which shops stitchers call home, and what they love about each one.

YOUR LNS PASSPORT
A stamp for every shop you visit. Photos to remember the trip. A list of the shops you want to visit next.

A WISHLIST FOR THE CANVASES YOU LOVE
Save canvases into collections. Christmas. For your mom. Maybe next year. No more losing canvases in your camera roll.

A STITCH LIBRARY, WITH REAL EXAMPLES
Every needlepoint stitch you might want to learn, with diagrams and real examples from other stitchers.

INSPIRATION THAT GOES SOMEWHERE
Bookmark what catches your eye — color combinations, finishing ideas, framing choices. Your visual notebook.

A COMMUNITY OF STITCHERS
Watch other stitchers' canvases go from kit to finished piece, and see exactly which threads, stitches, and canvases they used. New to needlepoint? You will not have to guess what to buy or which stitches to learn first.


FREE FOREVER

Your projects, your notions, and your wishlist stay free forever. The Skein is a yearly membership for stitchers who want a few extras and want to support what we are building.


THE STORY IS SHORT

Stitchpoint started with the questions stitchers kept asking each other. Which threads work for which canvases. What is already in the stash at home. How to learn a stitch you have never tried.

My wife needlepoints. She told me there should be an app for it. I started building it that day. Since then we have listened to stitchers, canvas designers, shop owners, and finishers. They told us what they actually needed. We build that.

Stitchpoint is for them, and for everyone who finds their way to needlepoint next.


WORKS BEST FOR

Needlepoint canvases, hand-painted and printed. Threads from any brand you collect. Stitches from bargello to basketweave. Stitchers who track their WIPs, build a wishlist, plan a shop hop, and want to see how the community fills a background.

Made with care for the needlepoint community.

KC Needlepoint stands as the leading provider in the needlepoint community, renowned for its vast selection of quality canvases, comprehensive selection of fibers, and personalized customer service. Situated in the heart of Kansas City, this shop caters to both seasoned needlepoint enthusiasts and beginners looking to embark on a new craft journey. With a commitment to excellence and creativity, KC Needlepoint has become a trusted name for all things needlepoint.

At KC Needlepoint, customers can explore a curated inventory that features everything a needlepointer could need. The shop offers an extensive range of canvases, threads, and accessories from top brands in the industry. Whether you are seeking hand-painted canvases with intricate designs or blank canvases for a custom project, KC Needlepoint has a huge selection to meet your needs. The shop also stocks a diverse array of threads, including wool, silk, cotton, and metallics, available in a rich palette of colors to bring your needlepoint projects to life.

For those looking to start a new project with all the necessary materials bundled together, KC Needlepoint provides customized needlepoint kits. These kits are carefully assembled to include a canvas, appropriate threads, needles, and detailed instructions, ensuring that stitchers have everything they need to complete their project. Whether you are interested in creating a beautiful home décor item, a unique gift, or a piece of wearable art, these kits are tailored to inspire creativity and simplify the needlepoint process.

Customer satisfaction is at the forefront of KC Needlepoint's mission. The shop prides itself on offering a welcoming and supportive atmosphere where customers feel valued and appreciated. Knowledgeable staff members are always available to offer expert advice, assist with product selection, and provide tips for improving needlepoint techniques. Additionally, KC Needlepoint offers an online store that you can shop through this mobile app, making it convenient for customers to browse and purchase their favorite products from the comfort of their homes or on the go.

KC Needlepoint is more than just a store; it is a vibrant community hub for needlepoint enthusiasts. 
Education is a core pillar of KC Needlepoint's offerings.  We are with you from start to finish on every project. Use this app to stay up to date on the latest happenings in the industry by reading our blog, learn new needlepoint stitches in The Stitch Vault, and get the basics you need to get started stitching.

Stitchly is the best cross stitch pattern maker app on iPhone and iPad. Easily create your own cross stitch patterns with this simple yet powerful app.

• Perfect for beginners and professionals
• Convert your photos or draw your own designs
• Use DMC and Anchor thread, plus lots more
• Use 1/4, 1/2, 3/4, backstitches, and French knots
• Export your work as a printable PDF
• Track your progress in the app
• No subscriptions (pay once, enjoy forever)


IT WORKS LIKE MAGIC

When converting a photo, use our custom-built wizard tool to effortlessly choose the best settings for your image and see the results instantly.


TRACE OVER IMAGES

When drawing your own designs, you can show an image in the background. This can be super helpful as a reference to trace over. You can also show the original image after converting a photo, which makes tidying up your patterns even easier.


MAKE YOUR MASTERPIECE

Once your pattern is finished and you’re ready to get stitching, simply press play. You can view your pattern in the app, highlight symbols, and mark stitches as completed using the progress tracker.


JOIN THOUSANDS OF HAPPY CUSTOMERS...

"I can’t overstate my love for Stitchly. Every time I don’t see it on a top 10 softwares for cross stitch I’m shook. I‘ve been making and selling patterns for 5 years and have tried 3 other programs but Stitchly’s aesthetics, simplicity, and constant feature updates make it my number one favorite of all time." - By Nic806 on the App Store

"This app is exactly what I’ve been looking for! I had been eyeing a few desktop apps but this app provides all the features I need in a cheaper, convenient, portable app- even better! I love how easy it is to make patterns and export them, even including the number of skeins needed in the export is so helpful." - By reydiant on the App Store

"The best app for anyone that likes cross stitch. I’ve saved so much money on buying patterns and it’s also so much fun to be able to design my own. Love it. I never spend money on apps but this one was definitely worth it." - By TJ_172940 on the App Store


BECOME AN AMAZING DESIGNER

Our mission is to make it easier and more fun to create your own cross stitch designs. Why? Because being creative makes you happier and healthier.


AS FEATURED BY APPLE

Stitchly has been featured as App of the Day on the App Store. We are incredibly proud of this milestone and wish to thank all our wonderful customers for their continued support.


FAQ

Is the full version a one-time purchase?
Yes. There are no subscriptions. You can create and export as many patterns as you like with the one-time purchase.

Can I unlock my other devices using the same purchase?
Yes. You can unlock the full version on your iPhone, iPad and Mac (M1 chip or later) with just one purchase.

Can I share the purchase with my family?
Yes. Family Sharing is enabled.

Can I sell my patterns?
Yes. You can also add your store details to your PDF exports.

Do I have to buy the materials separately?
Yes. The app is only for creating patterns.

Can I use Stitchly for needlepoint?
Yes. Many of our customers use the Stitchly app to create both cross stitch and needlepoint patterns. When using the app for needlepoint, just treat each square as one canvas intersection.

Is Stitchly an alternative to Stitch Fiddle?
Yes. Stitchly is an app, whereas Stitch Fiddle is an online platform. Stitchly is not affiliated with Stitch Fiddle.

Where is my data stored?
Your data is stored on your device. All processing is done locally on your device. Your data is never transmitted to third parties.


TRY IT NOW

Try Stitchly now on your iPhone, iPad or Mac. The full version is a one-time purchase.

Find out more at stitchly.com

Pointed is your digital needlepoint store — save designs, stay organized, and stitch smarter. Built for stitchers, by a stitcher.
Whether you're a first-time needlepointer or have a stash that's outgrown your craft room, Pointed brings every piece of your stitching life into one beautiful, organized place.
NEW: THE UPDATED FIBER EXPLORER 
A rainbow of opportunity, at your fingertips. Now, with the ability to search through your stash! Find the perfect thread four new ways:
• COLOR WHEEL — Spin to discover fibers in any shade. Tap for product info; long-press to add to your wishlist, stash, or a project.
• BARCODE SCANNER — Point your camera at any fiber card and instantly see brand, fiber content, UPC, and where to buy it.
• STITCH PLAN — Want an exact color match for your canvas? Tap any color in your wishlisted or stashed canvases to find the perfect fiber for it.
• FIBER LIBRARY — Browse thousands of fibers across every major brand and 12 color families.
• PALETTES — Compare colors, save color combos, and plan your kits with the Fiber Explorer! Save palettes to a project, and add fibers from palettes directly into your stash and projects.
WISHLIST
Save canvases from any shop with one tap. Add notes and tags. Always know what you want — and stop using your camera roll as a wishlist.
STASH
Your complete needlepoint inventory, finally organized. Track every thread, canvas, fiber, and accessory you own — with status (Owned, Needed, Out of), quantity, dye lot, and notes. Stop buying duplicates. Start stitching with confidence.
PROJECTS
From kitted to finished, Pointed tracks every step. Set a start date and watch your day counter grow. Link your stash and wishlist items to each project. Upload progress photos with Pointed Plus. Filter and search across all your projects by status, tag, or name.
SHOPS
Explore a map of local needlepoint stores around the US!
Browse highlighted needlepoint retailers - featuring Stitching It Eklektik: needlepoint and no rules. Paste a link from any supported store and Pointed does the rest.
POINTED SOCIAL
Follow other stitchers. See their wishlists and projects. Share your progress and inspiration with the community - now through social links! Private accounts available — you're always in control of who sees your stash.
ANALYTICS
See your stitching stats at a glance — total projects, stash breakdown, average project duration, oldest unstarted, and yes, even your WIP purgatory (collapsible, no judgment). Right on your profile.
POINTED PLUS
Upgrade to Pointed Plus for unlimited wishlist and stash items, project photo uploads, and the Inspiration section. Now with the ability to save links to sites, videos, and more. 
 FINISHING TRACKER (Pointed Plus)
finished isn't Finished — and the months in between are where pieces get lost track of. The Finishing Tracker follows every project from the final stitch until it's back in your hands:
• Set a goal for any occasion and get a send-by date worked back from your finisher's turnaround
• Keep the whole send-out story: finisher, order number, deposit, invoice, and tracking both ways
• Self-finishing? Track your own stages, from blocking to final touches
• Spec the finish — type, fabric, cording, monogram — linked right to items in your stash
• Save reference photos before your piece ships, for peace of mind (and insurance!)
Billed monthly or annually through your Apple ID. Family Sharing included. Cancel anytime.
No ads. Just needlepoint.

Learn to needlepoint, one stitch at a time.

Needlepoint Studio teaches you the whole stitch library with animated, step-by-step lessons. Every stitch draws itself on the canvas, stroke by stroke, with a needle that shows exactly where the yarn goes. Play it, pause it, step through a single stitch, or slow it to half speed until it clicks. No other needlepoint app teaches this way.

FOLLOW A GUIDED PATH
Start with First Stitches, free for everyone. Then work through curated lessons in Beautiful Backgrounds, Texture Sampler, and Decorative Accents. Each path builds real skills in the order a teacher would give them.

KEEP YOUR WHOLE CRAFT IN ONE STUDIO
• Track every canvas from "kitted up" to finished, with progress photos and a before/after compare.
• Time your stitching sessions and watch your streak and weekly minutes add up. A running timer stays on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island.
• Give a canvas a finish-by date and see, in plain language, whether you're on pace to make it.
• Organize your fiber stash and stretcher bars: brand, color, count, and how much you have left.
• Flag what you're low on, then take the whole To Buy list to the shop as a shopping list, so you never buy the same thread twice.

KNOW WHAT IT'S ALL WORTH
See the value of your collection at a glance, and export an insurance-ready CSV or PDF report: proof of everything you own, ready when you need it.

CELEBRATE EVERY FINISH
Finished canvases join a gallery grouped by year. Share a single project's before-and-after, or a whole year of stitching, as a card made for the feed.

YOURS, EVERYWHERE, FOREVER
Everything backs up privately through your own iCloud account. Get a new iPhone and your studio is already there. Add Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, including a new stitch to learn every day. Log a session with one tap or by asking Siri, and jump to any project or stitch from Spotlight search.

GO PRO YOUR WAY: SUBSCRIBE, OR PAY ONCE AND OWN IT FOREVER
Studio Pro unlocks the full stitch library, all learning paths, unlimited projects, finish-by pacing, collection and shopping-list export, the Year-in-Review card, and nine extra studio themes. Choose a monthly or yearly subscription (yearly starts with a 3-day free trial), or make a single lifetime purchase that's yours forever. Every plan works on all your devices and shares with your household through Family Sharing. Your data is never locked behind Pro: everything you've made stays visible, editable, and synced even if a subscription ends.

ORTganizer is the ultimate companion for stitchers who want to bring clarity, creativity, and organization to every needlepoint project. Designed with the needs of hobbyists and serious crafters in mind, ORTganizer helps you manage threads, track progress, and place stitch tags directly on your canvas image — all in one intuitive app.

Whether you’re starting a new design or revisiting a favorite piece, ORTganizer keeps your projects organized, your threads cataloged, and your stitching experience magical.

Thread Management:
Build a personal catalog of threads with brand, color code, color name, type, hex color, quantity, and notes.
Quickly browse and select threads when tagging your canvas.

Project Organization:
Create and store projects with metadata like name, description, image, creation date, and deadline.
Load existing projects instantly from our secure database.
Track deadlines with automatic reminders of days remaining or overdue status.
Keep your project images safe and accessible.

Smart Tagging:
Tap directly on your project image to place tags at normalized coordinates, ensuring accuracy no matter how you zoom or pan.
Assign sequential tag numbers automatically for easy reference.
Save tags to your project database with references to threads or stitches, plus custom labels.
Reload saved tags seamlessly when reopening a project, so your work is always preserved.

Stitch Integration:
Explore a growing catalog of stitches with IDs, names, categories, images, and tutorial links.
Tag your canvas with predefined stitches or create custom stitches.
Access external tutorials and reference images directly from within the app, making learning new techniques effortless.

Image Handling:
Load and display your project’s image file with full zoom and pan support.
Normalize tap positions to image coordinates, ensuring tags stay consistent across devices and screen sizes.
Clamp normalized values to prevent runaway tags outside the image bounds.
Enjoy a clean, responsive interface that adapts to your workflow.

Why ORTganizer?
Needlepoint is more than a craft — it’s a journey of patience, creativity, and detail. ORTganizer was built to honor that journey by giving stitchers the tools to stay organized, inspired, and confident. From cataloging threads to tagging stitches, from tracking deadlines to accessing tutorials, ORTganizer is your all‑in‑one project manager.
Whether you’re a beginner learning your first stitch or an experienced crafter managing multiple canvases, ORTganizer adapts to your needs. It’s practical, playful, and designed to make every project feel rewarding.

ORTganizer — because every stitch deserves a place, and every project deserves to shine.
